SUBJECT: SE-8: POSSIBLE COMMUNIST OBJECTIVES IN SUGGESTING
A CEASE FIRE IN KOREA

THE PROBLEM

To exemine possible Soviet objectives in proposing a cease fire and armistice in Korea,

ESTIMATE

THE COMMUNIST CEASE FIRE PROPOSAL

de On 23 June, Soviet UN Chief Delegate Malik, speaking on a UN program series, presented a vague suggestion that the "belligerents" should start discussions for a "cease fire and armistice" in Kerea, On 27 June Malik's statement was clarified to some extent by Soviet Acting Foreign Minister Gromyke, who stated to US Ambassador Kirk that the representatives of parties fighting in Korea ("representatives of the Unified Command plus ———)

Gromyko also said that assurances against resumption of hostilities should be dis= cussed between the military representatives formating the terms of the military armistice,

(i) The Politburo may have reasoned that the mere announcement of a Soviet "desire" to bring about a cease-fire would be a potent propagande weapon in the Soviet "peace"
campaign, and that a subsequent accusation, however, fraudulent, that the UN refused nto: Cooperate in a peaceful settlement"
